passage:
Text 1
Planting more trees along city streets is one of the cheapest ways to cool neighborhoods during summer heat waves, since shade can lower surface temperatures by many degrees.

Text 2
City trees are often valued for their shade, but their roots and soil also absorb large amounts of rainwater, reducing the street flooding that heavy storms can cause.
stem: Based on the texts, both authors would most likely agree that ______
choices: planting trees along city streets can provide important benefits to neighborhoods.
the most important reason to plant city trees is to reduce flooding after heavy storms.
shade from trees has only a small effect on summer temperatures in most neighborhoods.
cities should replace their storm drains with trees in order to prevent street flooding.
steps: Text 1 values trees for cooling; Text 2 values them for flood control (while noting shade).
Both see real benefits in street trees.
Only Text 2 emphasizes flooding, neither says shade has a small effect, and neither suggests replacing drains.
key: "Both would agree" questions need a statement that fits each text.
